description: Manage OpenBSD system patches using syspatch.
examples:
- name: Apply all available system patches
  community.general.syspatch:

- name: Revert last patch
  community.general.syspatch:
    revert: one

- name: Revert all patches
  community.general.syspatch:
    revert: all

# NOTE: You can reboot automatically if a patch requires it:
- name: Apply all patches and store result
  community.general.syspatch:
  register: syspatch

- name: Reboot if patch requires it
  ansible.builtin.reboot:
  when: syspatch.reboot_needed

return_values.name: reboot_needed
return_values.description: Whether or not a reboot is required after an update. Returned: always Sample: true
